Fiction fare only — a cup is a move, not a prescription.Redo my math so that it’s different it needs to be more complexWorked for 1m 13sThe old math was care = printed + 2 if color matches. That’s gone. New still-room calculus is in WillowBend-Worlds.html. Open ∑ Still-room calculus on home, or read the slate under the cards during an hour. Care (what a card actually does) $$\text{care}^{*}=\left\lfloor\frac{(B+M+K+S+A)\cdot\lambda\cdot\sigma}{1+D}\right\rfloor$$ TermMeaningBNumber printed on the cardM+2 color match or Match type, +1 if the family word is on the cardK+1 if the last table item was a menu orderS+1 same type as last card, +2 listen→referA+1 per agenda thread named on the cardλAtmosphere: Quiet 1.15 · Normal 1.00 · Busy 0.92 · Overwhelmed 0.80σStage 1–4: 1.00, 0.88, 1.12, 0.95 (Settle → Activate)D0.12 × cards already played (later cards shrink) Two affliction tracks Instead of one HP bar, the hour splits: Plot ~58% (plus a small tag nudge) Weather the rest Both have to hit 0 to clear. A cup can move weather; a boundary card usually hits plot. RP (end of hour) $$\text{RP}=\mathrm{clamp}_{1}^{22}\big(5+4\cdot\text{clear}+\lfloor\text{careSum}\cdot 0.35\rfloor+\text{agenda}+\lfloor\text{table}/2\rfloor-\lfloor\text{plays}/5\rfloor\big)$$ Long sloppy hours pay less. Two agenda hits and a short table pay more. The slate under the hand shows the last expansion: B2 M2 K1 S0 A1 → care* 5 (plot 3 / weather 2). Fiction math only — not physiology.Put that on gameWorked for 29sThe formulas are on the game now — not just in a side sheet. WillowBend-Worlds.html Clinic home — banner at the top of the still-room: care* = floor( (B+M+K+S+A) × λ × σ / (1+D) ) RP = clamp 1..22 of 5 + 4·clear + floor(careSum×0.35) + agenda + floor(table/2) − floor(plays/5) plus the term legend. During an hour — sticky line at the top of the table: same care* equation, and Plot + Weather must both hit 0. The full banner also sits under the cards with the live slate. How to play

1. Open the door → Waiting Room: pick 1 of 3 patients
2. Form a working diagnosis (you can switch before locking confidence)
3. Rate confidence (calibrated scoring)
4. Intake → 3 protocol steps (live score shown)
5. Outcome from choices + luck · color–system match helps
6. After ~3 sessions or low Attention → Day Recap
7. Deck: full Session (costs Att) or free Practice diagnosis
8. Build Mastery, body map, Maya loyalty, remedies, Archive

Tone lock: competent, kind, slightly tired, never cruel. Never medical advice. Body systems are game fiction only.
